BiblicalUsage: Ham is a place name that appears only once, in the account of the kings who swept through Canaan before Abraham rescued Lot. In Genesis 14:5 Chedorlaomer and the kings with him smote the Zuzims in Ham, on their way to the battle that would draw Abraham out to fight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse matters because it sets the scene for Abraham's rescue: the invaders were already deep in the land, and God still gave Abraham the victory.
